from pathlib import Path
import os,json
root=Path('/data/hepta-learn-037c-20261112/target-cold-4ab-v1')
rows=[]
locks=Path('/proc/locks').read_text().splitlines()
for p in (root/'debug/.cargo-lock',root/'release/.cargo-lock',root/'.cargo-lock'):
 if not p.exists():
  rows.append({'path':str(p),'exists':False});continue
 s=p.stat(); key=f'{os.major(s.st_dev):02x}:{os.minor(s.st_dev):02x}:{s.st_ino}'
 matches=[x for x in locks if key in x.split()]
 owners=[]
 for line in matches:
  words=line.split(); idx=words.index(key);pid=int(words[idx-1]); proc=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
  try:
   owners.append({'pid':pid,'comm':(proc/'comm').read_text().strip(),'cwd':str((proc/'cwd').resolve(strict=True)),'exe':str((proc/'exe').resolve(strict=True)),'start_ticks':(proc/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]})
  except OSError as e: owners.append({'pid':pid,'error':str(e)})
 rows.append({'path':str(p),'inode':s.st_ino,'device':s.st_dev,'locks':matches,'owners':owners})
print(json.dumps({'kind':'read-only target lock observation','processes_signalled':False,'files_changed':False,'rows':rows}),flush=True)
